name: AIT Communications
summary: Melbourne dialup ISP (Australian Internet Technologies), Blackburn VIC, POPs across greater Melbourne; ceased operations by ~2002 (Cynosure delisted).

events.details: Earliest Wayback capture 25 Jan 1999 (aitnet.net), 'AIT Communications - Australian Internet Technologies'; Blackburn Vic 3130, ph (03) 9893 3855; POPs at Melbourne, Werribee, Dandenong, Ringwood, Kalkallo, Geelong, Croydon (per Cynosure).

Cynosure 2002 snapshot marks provider 'no longer listed ... ceased operations'; aitnet.net stopped serving retail content after Jan 1999 and returned only 302 redirects from Sep 2002; domain later reused by an unrelated site.
